summary: Round 1 has one genuinely strong shot (coast-rush.mp4) and a usable PLAY montage, but the bookends are weak. The hook emotes are either near-static or filmed from behind, the class looks do not read as Mage/Pirate/Thief/Warrior/Archer, and the PROGRESS beat is text cards with an empty rankings board and no visible level change. Six files are rejected (one loading screen, two empty frames, one cluttered quest panel with a text glitch, one render artefact, one counter bug); no real player names were found, every readable tag is on the placeholder list. All six beats need at least one recapture before this can be cut; priority order is HOOK, CREATE, PROGRESS, CTA, then HANG OUT and the Star Swarm and Open Stage fixes.
